_comment: Source of truth for published skill versions. Skills read this (cached daily, fail-silent) to tell users when an update is available. Bump the entry whenever you bump a skill's version.

changes: Explicit check, signed preview, apply and offline previous-installation recovery; no automatic updates.
Per-harness installation receipts, stable/pinned/main channels and separate protocol acceptance.
DO_NOT_TRACK and once-daily notice handling; actual dispatcher, updater and protocol hashes in reports.
Five focused information pages and deterministic, reconciled public evidence tables.
Visible FAQ, bounded review-output parsing and copyable evidence tables. Legacy unsigned release; not installable through the signature-enforcing updater.
